Hazard Title: Vibration-related leak at compressor discharge piping
Hazard Description: Small-bore tubing, fittings and flanges on compressor discharge subject to vibration and thermal cycling; fatigue or loosening of joints.
Potential Incident: Gas release in the compressor shelter, with ignition potential.
Potential Consequences: Flash fire or confined-space gas accumulation; injury to operators; equipment damage and production loss.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Fixed gas detection with alarm; area classified as hazardous; operator rounds each shift (assumed, illustrative).
Recommended Additional Controls: Piping vibration and support review by a competent engineer; vibration monitoring on compressor package; confirm gas-detection-initiated shutdown by documented functional test.
Residual Rating Basis: Likelihood credited one level for engineered vibration control and tested shutdown. Severity unchanged: a release that does occur has the same worst credible outcome.

Hazard Title: Gas detector calibration not tracked
Hazard Description: Calibration and bump-test dates for fixed detectors are held informally; detectors can drift out of calibration without being noticed.
Potential Incident: A leak occurs while the detector is out of calibration and is not alarmed.
Potential Consequences: Delayed leak detection; larger release; delayed shutdown and evacuation.
Persons or Assets Affected: Operators, nearby personnel; compressor and storage areas
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Annual detector service by a vendor (assumed); ad hoc function checks.
Recommended Additional Controls: Detector register with calibration due dates; fault and low-range alarms displayed in the control room; review of detector coverage and voting logic by a competent person.
Residual Rating Basis: Fault alarms and coverage review reduce the chance that a leak coincides with an undetected failed detector; credited two levels at most, one claimed.
Specialist Assessment Required: Yes: fire and gas system competent person

Hazard Title: Safety trips or alarms inhibited without control
Hazard Description: High-pressure, high-temperature or vibration trips may be bypassed or alarms inhibited to keep the unit running, without a managed record or time limit.
Potential Incident: Compressor runs outside its protected envelope; overpressure or mechanical failure.
Potential Consequences: Equipment rupture or major release; fatality potential from fragmentation or fire.
Persons or Assets Affected: Operators in compressor area; compressor package
Recommended Additional Controls: Safety-system override and inhibit register with time limits and senior approval; independent review of trip settings and protective functions by a functional-safety specialist.
Residual Rating Basis: Likelihood credited one level once overrides are controlled and trip settings independently reviewed. Severity stays at 5 because the worst credible outcome is unchanged.

Hazard Title: Pressure relief devices past test interval
Hazard Description: Relief valve test and certification dates are not centrally tracked; devices may remain in service past their interval.
Potential Incident: Overpressure event with a relief device that fails to lift correctly.
Potential Consequences: Vessel or piping overpressure; rupture or major release.
Persons or Assets Affected: Station personnel; compression and storage equipment
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Test performed when remembered by the maintenance team (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Pressure-relief register with test due dates; testing by a competent, accredited provider; supervisor review of overdue items monthly.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control only, so likelihood credit capped at one level. Relief device reliability still depends on competent testing, which needs technical verification.
Specialist Assessment Required: Yes: accredited pressure equipment inspection body

Hazard Title: Oil leaks near hot surfaces in compressor area
Hazard Description: Lubricating oil weeps or leaks from fittings and drains near hot surfaces and electrical equipment.
Potential Incident: Oil fire in the compressor shelter.
Potential Consequences: Burn injuries; equipment damage; potential escalation to a gas release.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Drip trays at some points; oily rags removed during rounds (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Insulate or shield hot surfaces; fit drip trays and leak containment; set leak-repair timeframes; weekly housekeeping inspection.
Residual Rating Basis: Engineered shielding and containment reduce ignition opportunity by one level; consequence unchanged.

Hazard Title: Abnormal suction conditions not recognised
Hazard Description: Suction pressure swings or liquid carryover are not recognised early; alarms are cleared without checking the cause.
Potential Incident: Compressor damage and potential gas release.
Potential Consequences: Mechanical damage, release, production loss.
Recommended Additional Controls: Inlet separator level alarms and trend displays; written operator response guide for abnormal suction conditions, approved by the equipment supplier.
Residual Rating Basis: Level alarm and trend display give earlier warning. One level of likelihood credit; consequence unchanged.

Hazard Title: Storage pressure equipment inspection dates not tracked
Hazard Description: Periodic inspection requirements for storage vessels and cascades are not tracked in one register; corrosion or fatigue damage could go undetected.
Potential Incident: Storage vessel or piping failure.
Potential Consequences: Major release, fire or explosion; fatality potential; off-site effects.
Persons or Assets Affected: All site personnel; neighbouring premises; storage assets
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Annual visual check by operators; inspection by contractor when arranged (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Pressure equipment register with inspection scheme, intervals set by a competent person, and escalation of overdue inspections to the Operations Manager.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control, one level of likelihood credit. Residual rating depends on inspections actually being performed by a competent body.

Hazard Title: Vehicle impact on storage cascade or piping
Hazard Description: Vehicles reverse or manoeuvre near storage assemblies and piping with limited physical protection.
Potential Incident: Vehicle strikes storage equipment or piping.
Potential Consequences: Damage to equipment; gas release; fire potential.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Yard speed limit; reversing banksman when available (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Crash barriers and bollards around storage and piping; marked pedestrian and vehicle routes; reversing restrictions in the storage approach.
Residual Rating Basis: Physical barriers act directly on the failure mode and are credited with one level; severity is unchanged.

Hazard Title: Unauthorised access to storage area
Hazard Description: Weak control of gates and perimeter allows unauthorised persons or vehicles near storage assets.
Potential Incident: Tampering with equipment or introduction of ignition sources.
Potential Consequences: Gas release or fire; injury to the intruder and staff; property loss.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Fence and gate; security guard on days (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Perimeter fence integrity checks, controlled gate entry log, CCTV coverage of storage, night patrols.
Residual Rating Basis: Engineered access control reduces likelihood; consequence unchanged.

Hazard Title: Emergency isolation not remotely available
Hazard Description: Storage isolation relies on local manual valves; access during a leak may be unsafe or delayed.
Potential Incident: Leak continues because isolation is delayed.
Potential Consequences: Longer release duration; escalation to fire; larger evacuation.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Manual isolation valves; operators trained on location (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Assess remotely operated emergency isolation valves and an emergency shutdown station; functionally test emergency shutdown scheme at defined intervals.
Residual Rating Basis: Remote isolation directly shortens release duration; likelihood of an uncontrolled prolonged release credited one level.

Hazard Title: Ignition sources in hazardous areas not controlled
Hazard Description: Non-certified electrical equipment, portable devices and idling vehicles may be present in areas where gas could accumulate.
Potential Incident: Ignition of a small release.
Potential Consequences: Flash fire; burn injuries; escalation.
Recommended Additional Controls: Hazardous area classification review by a competent engineer; audit of electrical equipment against the classification; controlled entry for vehicles and portable devices.
Residual Rating Basis: Verified equipment suitability removes common ignition sources; one level credited. Requires specialist verification.

Hazard Title: Transfer hose damage or overdue retirement
Hazard Description: Flexible transfer hoses and connections are not consistently tracked for test dates and retirement; abrasion and fatigue damage can be missed.
Potential Incident: Hose or fitting failure during transfer.
Potential Consequences: High-pressure release with whipping hose; injury to operators; ignition potential.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Visual check before use; supplier test when requested (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Hose register with test and retirement dates; restraints on transfer hoses; pre-use inspection criteria with rejection standards agreed with the hose supplier.
Residual Rating Basis: Restraints limit consequence of hose failure for people but not release itself; one level of likelihood credited for registered retirement and restraint.

Hazard Title: Coupling connection or disconnection error
Operational Activity: Connection and disconnection at loading bay
Hazard Description: Connection or disconnection sequence is not followed or verified; operator may begin before pressure state is confirmed.
Potential Incident: Release at the coupling during connection or disconnection.
Potential Consequences: Gas release near operators; ignition potential; injury from hose movement.
Recommended Additional Controls: Interlocked or keyed couplings and pressure indication that must show safe state before disconnection; supervised connection checklist; second-person verification.
Residual Rating Basis: Interlocks make the error harder to commit; two levels of likelihood credit. Consequence unchanged because a release still has the same outcome.
Specialist Assessment Required: Yes: coupling and interlock design review

Hazard Title: Trailer not earthed or restrained during transfer
Hazard Description: Earthing and wheel restraint are applied by habit rather than verified before transfer.
Potential Incident: Static discharge or trailer movement during transfer.
Potential Consequences: Ignition or hose tension release; injury.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Earthing clamp and wheel chocks available (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Earthing interlock that must be proven before transfer starts; fixed wheel stops in the bay.
Residual Rating Basis: Interlock removes dependence on habit; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Exclusion zone not enforced during transfer
Hazard Description: Bystanders, visitors and vehicles can enter the transfer area while connections are live.
Potential Incident: Person or vehicle in the zone when a release occurs.
Potential Consequences: Injury from release, fire or hose movement; vehicle impact on transfer equipment.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Painted lines and signs; verbal reminders (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Physical barriers or gates for the transfer zone; visitor and contractor access permission via supervisor; beacon lights showing transfer in progress.
Residual Rating Basis: Barriers help, but people can still enter for urgent tasks; only one level credited, so residual stays High until barriers and permission rules are verified in operation.

Hazard Title: Communication failure during transfer
Operational Activity: Loading bay and control room communication
Hazard Description: Radio or phone links between the loading bay and control room fail or are unclear during transfer.
Potential Incident: Delayed shutdown after a release.
Potential Consequences: Longer release duration; delayed escalation.
Recommended Additional Controls: Redundant communication means and an emergency stop at the loading position; regular function checks logged each shift.
Residual Rating Basis: Redundancy and a local emergency stop reduce the chance of delayed response; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Single person connecting at customer site
Hazard Description: A lone driver performs connection and disconnection at customer sites with no one to verify steps or raise an alarm.
Potential Incident: Connection error or leak with delayed alarm.
Potential Consequences: Undetected release; injury; delayed emergency call.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Driver training; customer contact available by phone (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Second-person rule for connection and disconnection at customer sites; customer interface agreement defining who attends; supervisor audits at customer sites.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control, one level of likelihood credit.

Hazard Title: Customer site not assessed before first delivery
Hazard Description: Delivery positions and nearby ignition sources, overhead lines and surfaces are not assessed before first delivery.
Potential Incident: Release near customer ignition sources or unstable trailer position.
Potential Consequences: Fire or explosion potential; trailer instability; third-party exposure.
Recommended Additional Controls: Customer site survey before first delivery covering stand-off, hazardous equipment, overhead lines and ground; customer interface agreement; delivery only to approved positions.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level of likelihood credit. Site survey quality needs competent review.
Specialist Assessment Required: Yes: site hazard assessment by competent person

Hazard Title: Driver fatigue on long routes
Hazard Description: Long routes and variable schedules with limited visibility of driving hours increase fatigue risk.
Potential Incident: Loss of control or collision due to fatigue.
Potential Consequences: Fatality potential for driver and public; release and fire if trailer is damaged.
Recommended Additional Controls: Journey management with driving-hour limits and rest planning; telematics fatigue and speed alerts; dispatch rules preventing added legs beyond limits.
Residual Rating Basis: Telematics and rules help but fatigue depends on rest quality that cannot be fully engineered; one level credited, residual remains High.

Hazard Title: Vehicle defects not caught before departure
Hazard Description: Brakes, tyres and suspension defects on prime movers and trailers can go undetected between services.
Potential Incident: Loss of control, tyre failure or brake failure on road.
Potential Consequences: Collision or rollover; release potential.
Recommended Additional Controls: Preventive maintenance plan with defect close-out before dispatch; tyre management programme; supervisor review of overdue services.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Poor journey planning and route risk
Hazard Description: Routes are selected on time and distance without a documented risk assessment of road conditions, closures and populated areas.
Potential Incident: Increased exposure to collisions and delays in emergencies.
Potential Consequences: Collision; limited emergency response access.
Recommended Additional Controls: Route risk assessment with approved routes and alternatives; dispatch confirmation of road closures; limits on night driving where practicable.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Road collision involving a laden tube trailer
Hazard Description: A collision or rollover involving a laden tube trailer on public roads, including third-party actions beyond driver control.
Potential Incident: Trailer damaged in collision or rollover.
Potential Consequences: Fatality potential; fire or release; wider public impact.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Trained drivers; speed limits; trailer designed for transport (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Speed limiters, collision-warning systems and stability aids on prime movers; defensive driving programme; emergency information carried by drivers.
Residual Rating Basis: Engineering aids reduce likelihood by one level. Severity stays 5 because worst credible outcome in populated areas is unchanged.

Hazard Title: Pre-trip tube trailer inspection inconsistent
Hazard Description: Pre-trip checks vary by driver and are signed without full completion.
Potential Incident: Defect on trailer, valve guards or securement is missed.
Potential Consequences: Release or load shift on road.
Recommended Additional Controls: Standard checklist with electronic submission and supervisor sign-off before departure; spot audits of walk-around completion.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Delivery-site hazards on arrival
Hazard Description: Restricted access, overhead obstructions, soft ground and uncontrolled public presence at delivery locations.
Potential Incident: Trailer instability, collision with obstruction or exposure of the public.
Potential Consequences: Equipment damage; delay; injury.
Recommended Additional Controls: Site access criteria documented in the customer survey; banksman for restricted sites; stop-work rule if conditions are unsuitable.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Inadequate isolation before work on gas lines
Operational Activity: Maintenance on gas piping and equipment
Hazard Description: Isolation and depressurisation are confirmed verbally or by one person, without independent verification before opening a line.
Potential Incident: Release of trapped gas when a line is opened.
Potential Consequences: Fire or explosion; fatality potential.
Recommended Additional Controls: Permit-to-work with isolation certificates and independent verification before breaking containment; provision for positive isolation where feasible; competence assessment for isolating authorities.
Residual Rating Basis: Positive isolation and independent verification credited two levels. Severity stays at 5. Residual remains High and requires technical verification.

Hazard Title: Hot work without adequate gas testing or controls
Hazard Description: Hot work performed in or near hazardous areas without recorded gas testing and fire watch.
Potential Incident: Ignition of residual or leaking gas.
Potential Consequences: Fire or explosion; fatality potential.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Hot work permit form; fire extinguisher at the job (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Substitute cold-cutting or mechanical methods where feasible; hot work permit requiring recorded gas test and fire watch; permit review by the HSE officer.
Residual Rating Basis: Substitution applies only to some jobs; one level credited. Residual remains Extreme-adjacent High.
Specialist Assessment Required: Yes: hot work and permit specialist

Hazard Title: Maintenance by unauthorised or unqualified staff
Hazard Description: Operators or untrained staff may attempt repair or adjustment outside their competence.
Potential Incident: Improper repair leading to a leak or equipment damage.
Potential Consequences: Gas release; injury.
Recommended Additional Controls: Competency matrix and authorisation list for each maintenance task; supervisor approval and lockable controls for restricted equipment.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Contractor unfamiliar with site hazards
Hazard Description: Contractors enter site without full induction, supervision or knowledge of emergency arrangements.
Potential Incident: Contractor error or exposure to a release or fire.
Potential Consequences: Injury; fire; production disruption.
Recommended Additional Controls: Contractor prequalification, site-specific induction, competence verification and named site supervision; contractor performance reviews.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Undocumented work authorisation
Hazard Description: Verbal approvals for maintenance work; conflicting activities and missed isolations are possible.
Potential Incident: Conflicting tasks, missed isolation or uncontrolled work.
Potential Consequences: Injury; release.
Recommended Additional Controls: Permit-to-work (written or electronic) for non-routine work with simultaneous operations check.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Poor housekeeping in workshop and yard
Hazard Description: Oil spills, loose materials and stored combustibles accumulate near work areas.
Potential Incident: Slip, trip or small fire.
Potential Consequences: Minor injury; small fire.
Recommended Additional Controls: Housekeeping standards, designated storage areas and monthly audits.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: PPE not matched to tasks
Hazard Description: Flame-resistant clothing, antistatic footwear, gloves and hearing protection are not matched to tasks or consistently worn.
Potential Incident: Burn, injury or hearing damage.
Potential Consequences: Burns; hearing loss; hand injuries.
Recommended Additional Controls: PPE matrix by task; periodic issue and condition checks; supervisor spot checks.
Residual Rating Basis: PPE reduces severity by one level but not likelihood of the event.

Hazard Title: Slips, trips and falls on wet or oily surfaces and trailer steps
Hazard Description: Wet or oily concrete, worn steps and uneven surfaces in yard and trailer access areas.
Potential Incident: Fall or slip injury.
Potential Consequences: Sprains, fractures, head injury.
Recommended Additional Controls: Anti-slip surfacing and handrails on access steps; drainage improvements; spill clean-up rule.
Residual Rating Basis: Surfacing and handrails reduce likelihood by one level.

Hazard Title: Manual handling of hoses and fittings
Hazard Description: Heavy hose assemblies and fittings handled without aids.
Potential Incident: Back or limb injury.
Potential Consequences: Musculoskeletal injury.
Recommended Additional Controls: Provide lifting aids and hose supports; refresh manual handling training.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Inadequate safety training and refreshers
Hazard Description: Refresher training for gas hazards, loading and emergency response is not scheduled by a competence matrix.
Potential Incident: Procedural error by an operator or driver.
Potential Consequences: Release; injury.
Recommended Additional Controls: Competence matrix with assessed training and refreshers; training records linked to authorisation to work.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Weak hazard and near-miss reporting culture
Hazard Description: Staff under-report near misses and unsafe conditions because of limited feedback or fear of blame.
Potential Incident: Missed learning opportunities lead to repeat events.
Potential Consequences: Delayed correction of hazards; higher chance of serious events.
Recommended Additional Controls: Simple mobile reporting channel, non-punitive reporting policy and visible feedback within an agreed timeframe.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Delayed escalation of a suspected gas leak
Hazard Description: Staff may try to locate or fix a suspected leak before raising the alarm.
Potential Incident: Escalation delay increases the size of an event.
Potential Consequences: Larger release; injury.
Recommended Additional Controls: Report-first rule with stop-work and evacuate triggers; scenario drills testing recognition and response.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Muster and evacuation not reliably accounted
Hazard Description: Assembly points and headcount arrangements for staff, visitors and contractors are not routinely rehearsed.
Potential Incident: Persons unaccounted for in an emergency.
Potential Consequences: Injury or fatality from delayed accounting.
Recommended Additional Controls: Muster system with named headcount officers and visitor and contractor register; evacuation drills with timed accounting.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: Emergency communication failure
Hazard Description: Contact lists outdated; no reliable backup communication in an emergency.
Potential Incident: Delayed external help.
Potential Consequences: Longer event duration.
Existing Assumed Controls (illustrative): Contact list posted in the control room (assumed).
Recommended Additional Controls: Backup communication, quarterly contact list check, tested call-out procedure.
Residual Rating Basis: Backup communication is credited one level.

Hazard Title: Emergency drills not covering key scenarios
Hazard Description: Drills do not cover a tube trailer release or a fire at the loading bay, so response is untested.
Potential Incident: Poor response to a real event.
Potential Consequences: Larger consequences.
Recommended Additional Controls: Annual scenario drill programme including tube trailer release and fire at the loading bay, with a recorded debrief and actions.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.

Hazard Title: No liaison with external responders for road incidents
Hazard Description: Arrangements with local fire services and emergency contacts for a road incident with a tube trailer are not established.
Potential Incident: Delayed or inappropriate external response.
Potential Consequences: Larger consequences; responder exposure.
Recommended Additional Controls: Liaison with fire services on routes; emergency information cards carried by drivers; dispatch call-out guide.
Residual Rating Basis: Administrative control; one level credited.
